description: Returns the shareholders of one company from SEC filings: institutional managers (Form 13F), holders above 5% (Schedule 13D/G), and directors, officers and 10% owners (Forms 3, 4 and 5), each with shares, share of the company, date and filing. Also: total declared ownership as a low and a high bound (`declaredOwnership`), the `coverage` of the 13F quarter, the quarter's declared moves (`moves`; 'sales' and the other values list them in full), insiders in office, the funds that report the shares (Form N-PORT), and the 13F history since the end of 2019. Use it when the user asks who owns a company, its largest shareholders, or who bought or sold its shares. Report ownership as the range given, never one number; when `coverage.complete` is false the totals are a floor; a 13D/G holder `below` 5% has not necessarily sold. `howToRead` explains each figure, and each holder's `holder` is accepted by get_holders. A pre-IPO company (e.g. 'anthropic') returns its prospectus's principal stockholders, officers and directors, fully diluted capital, Amazon's and Google's non-voting stakes (a floor) and its funds.

moves.description: Declared moves: 'summary' (default: the quarter's counts, largest sales and buys, every Schedule 13D/G move of the period, insiders), or a full list of the quarter's 13F moves, largest first: 'sales' (reductions and exits), 'exits', 'buys' (new holders and increases), 'all'.

movesLimit.description: Moves to list when `moves` is not 'summary' (default 50, max 500).

movesOffset.description: Skip this many moves (pagination: the previous answer's `next`).

symbol.description: Ticker or company name, e.g. NVDA, AMD, ASML, 'nvidia', 'taiwan semiconductor'. Case-insensitive.

name: get_ownership
title: Shareholders of a company
